🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Why does ChatGPT suddenly forget what we talked about? It's not being rude; it literally has no memory!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 ChatGPT and other LLMs don't 'store' memories like we do.
🔹 Every single reply involves re-reading your entire conversation history.
🔹 Once your chat gets too long, the oldest parts are silently 'forgotten' to make space for new input!
